notes:
Conditions now understand how people actually type them.

"If they are vertical, crop them" and "if its vertical, mute it" were being ignored — Crisp only recognised the exact phrasing "if it is", so a plural or a missing apostrophe meant the condition was skipped and the edit ran on any clip. Both work now, along with "they're", "the clips are", and the rest. Ordinary requests are unaffected: a gift video is still just a video.
